note: Damage-affecting relics only. Each has 3 levels; only level-3 values are confirmed (Bronze Press Damage Up 40@L3 user-verified in game), L1/L2 are guesses. mode 'mult' + group: percentages in the same group (relic + weapon bonus) SUM, then the group multiplies the total - per the research thread's stacking tests. mode 'add' joins the additive pool. requires gates on a status toggle. category 'pro' relics ignore tank category rules but use relic slots; grantsPower gates the tank power dropdown; Golden Pot upgrades the surge to 30% (user-verified: 5252 -> 6303 (+20%) native, -> 6826 (+30%) with Pot).

relics.name: Regal Scepter
relics.description: Damage dealt to Salmonids is increased after 3 consecutive attacks.

relics.name: Antique Corkscrew
relics.description: Damage is increased while HP is full.

relics.name: Family-Size Cutter
relics.description: Damage dealt to nearby Salmonids is increased.

relics.name: Bronze Press
relics.description: Weapon damage is increased for 9 sec after 30% of ink is used.

relics.name: Distant Gazer
relics.description: Damage dealt to far-off Salmonids is increased.

relics.name: Ancient Salmon Run Slab
relics.description: Damage is increased while you are in Danger.

relics.name: Golden Pot
relics.description: Grants the Power Tank power to any tank (+20% surge); on the Power Tank itself it upgrades the surge to +30%.

relics.name: Golden Frying Pan
relics.description: Any tank can use the Tactical Tank power (Ferment).
